name: Lissamphibia
blurb: Frogs, salamanders and caecilians. That they form one group is widely accepted; which fossil amphibians they descend from is still debated.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 159 ("Amphibians (Lissamphibia)")
